description: Updates are raised 7 days after release; security fixes bypass the cooldown.

packageRules.description: 7-day supply-chain cooldown: renovate/stability-days holds the branch back until the release is old enough.
Digest-pin the build and runtime bases: a floating distroless tag changes the shipped image with no commit.
Land low-risk bumps once CI is green.
Distroless digests need a human: GCR exposes no release timestamps, so the cooldown can't be enforced.
